acceptanceCriteria: A1: 任何进入 StructuralEvidence 的 NormalizedFact 必须同时具备 structural_evidence_contract、contract.validate() 成功且结构证据归属通过；否则只能作为 ValidatedFact 输出。

A2: Amazon Financial Statements 3 Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows...、Alphabet FINANCIAL INFORMATION Item 1 Financial Statements...、Walmart shareholder vote 原句、Microsoft issued a press release announcing its financial results 原句均不得进入 Structural Evidence。
A3: 真实结构变化仍可晋升，并保留可解释的 before_state、after_state、production_unit、effective_date、source 与 core_value_link。
A4: promotion gate fail-closed，不丢失已验证事实，不产生结构性证据计数或报告条目副作用。
A5: 通过 targeted RED/GREEN 回归、cargo fmt、cargo clippy -D warnings、cargo test --locked --workspace 及 Runtime preflight/verify/finish/archive 证据。
goal: 在 runtime StructuralEvidence promotion boundary 强制 contract 存在且可验证、结构契约字段完整，并用本次生产报告四条原句形成 RED 回归；保持真实合格的 before/after、production_unit、core_value_link 结构证据可晋升。
intent: 2026-08-31 Production Acceptance 发现 Structural Evidence promotion 仍可把 Amazon/Alphabet SEC 目录、Walmart shareholder vote、Microsoft earnings announcement 当作结构性证据；需要先锁死结构性晋升入口，确保不完整或无效 structural contract 的事实只能保留为 ValidatedFact。
outOfScope: WI-2 Cross-subject Attribution 与 subject_company 归属修复
Reference Model、Telegram 分页、生产 workflow/provider/secrets、data 分支与历史报告
source acquisition、ranking、报告版式及非结构性证据策略

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Amazon and Alphabet SEC table-of-contents passages are extracted as document leads.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Financial Statements 3 Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows... and FINANCIAL INFORMATION Item 1 Financial Statements... remain ValidatedFact and never StructuralEvidence.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Feed the exact 2026-08-31 production passages through document observation extraction and assert no structural evidence contract or structural report entry is produced.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Walmart shareholder-vote and Microsoft earnings-announcement passages are extracted as document leads.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The exact vote and financial-results announcement passages remain ValidatedFact and never StructuralEvidence.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Use the exact production passages as regression fixtures and assert the hard promotion boundary rejects them while preserving validated evidence.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A genuine production-system sentence with complete semantics is promoted.
scenarioCoverage.expected: A real change retains a valid contract with nonblank before_state, after_state, production_unit, source, effective_date, and core_value_link.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the existing positive engineering workflow fixture and assert StructuralEvidence plus every contract field.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Legacy or manually constructed dimension-only facts cannot enter the Structural Evidence report.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Missing or invalid structural contract is fail-closed and does not affect structural count or report section.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Render a fixture input containing a dimension-only fact and assert it is emitted only through the validated-fact path.
